storyTitle: Time to get those berry trellises into the ground.
description: A small workshop project finally joined the raspberry and blackberry patch.
noteLabel: Out in the garden · Late May 2026
noteHtml: A week earlier, I had built a couple of trellises for the raspberries and blackberries. Now it was finally time to get them installed and start training those plants to climb toward the sky.
